description:
Manage Interoperability System Default Settings (Ens.Config.DefaultSettings) — the production-portable settings override layer. A setting is keyed by a 4-tuple (production / item / hostClass / setting); any omitted slot defaults to '*' (applies to all). Actions:

- **list** (read): all settings rows, optionally filtered by any of the four key slots passed as filters.
- **get** (read): the single row for the exact tuple (returns found:false if absent).
- **set** (write): create or update the row for a tuple. Requires 'value'; accepts optional 'description' and 'deployable'.
- **delete** (write): remove the row for a tuple.

The mutating actions (set/delete) are opt-in under tool governance and are DISABLED by default until enabled via IRIS_GOVERNANCE. Saves and deletes auto-update the production modification flags on the server — no manual recompile is required.

action.description: Action to perform on the default setting(s)

deployable.description: Optional deployable flag — whether the setting is export-portable (for 'set').

hostClass.description: Host class name key slot (defaults to '*' = all host classes). Filter for 'list'; part of the exact tuple key for get/set/delete.

item.description: Item (config item) name key slot (defaults to '*' = all items). Filter for 'list'; part of the exact tuple key for get/set/delete.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to operate on a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

production.description: Production name key slot. For get/set/delete it is part of the exact tuple key and defaults to '*' (= the catch-all row) when omitted. For 'list' it is an OPTIONAL exact-match filter: OMIT it to return all productions; passing the literal '*' filters to only the wildcard-scoped ('*') rows, not all rows.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

setting.description: Setting name key slot (defaults to '*' = all settings). Filter for 'list'; part of the exact tuple key for get/set/delete.

name: iris_default_settings_manage
title: Manage System Default Settings
